Overview

Azure Cloud, explained

Ageing servers are expensive to replace and risky to rely on. Microsoft Azure lets you run servers, apps and desktops in the cloud, paying for what you use.

We assess what you have, recommend what should move and what shouldn't, then migrate with minimal disruption. Security, backups and cost monitoring are set up from the start, so your cloud bill stays predictable.

Who it's for

  • Businesses with servers near end of life
  • Teams needing secure remote access
  • Businesses building or hosting custom software
  • Organisations wanting reliable backup and recovery

Why it matters

Why Azure Cloud matters for your business

Servers age, warranties expire and replacing hardware is expensive. Microsoft Azure lets you run systems in the cloud and pay for what you use.

The cloud isn't automatically cheaper or safer. Poorly planned migrations lead to surprise bills and security gaps.

We assess, plan and migrate carefully, with security, backups and cost controls built in from the start.

  4. Training & support

Pricing

What affects the cost of Azure Cloud

  • Number of users and the Microsoft plan each needs
  • How much email and file data needs to move
  • Security requirements, devices and compliance needs
  • Whether you need custom apps, workflows or Copilot agents
  • Ongoing support and licence management

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • Your current licence list or Microsoft admin access
  • A list of users, devices and shared mailboxes
  • Where your files live today (servers, Dropbox, Google Drive and so on)
  • Any security or compliance requirements you need to meet

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Azure Cloud questions

Should everything move to the cloud?

Not always. We'll compare cost, performance and risk, and recommend what makes sense.

Can you manage Azure after migration?

Yes, through our Cloud Maintenance service.

How long does a migration take?

It depends on how many systems you have. We'll give you a timeline in your quote.

Can our custom software run on Azure?

Yes. We often host custom software and SaaS platforms on Azure.

Is Azure available worldwide?

Yes, and data can be hosted in your region.

Can we keep some systems on-premise?

Yes. A hybrid setup is often the best fit.

Where is our data stored?

You can choose Azure regions close to you, including Australia.

Who manages Azure after setup?

We can, through our Cloud Maintenance service.
